reviews.title: Quality control issue?
reviews.comment: There seems to be a QC issue with these power supplies. I ordered one and the fan bearing went out after an hour. I received a replacement and it did the same thing after a few days. Not sure if anyone else has reported this, but I hope this is fixed.
reviews.author: Jesus Osorio
